source.note: Exact rig_and_skin payload from the sunset-ayric-v2 ledger: the prod-calibrated-v001 mesh (19,588 triangles, 1.85 m, held collar-v001 artwork with region-bounded scalar material calibration) rigged by the portable landmark route (scripts/blender/rig_from_landmarks.py, 86 ue5_manny bones, heat weights, 100% coverage). gate_rig.py and deform_test.py passed in work/sunset-ayric-v2/rig/landmark-v001.

texture_waiver.reason: PROVISIONAL, for in-engine review only. Ayric asked on 2026-09-05 for the rigged character to replace Manny in the workshop demo so he can walk around and judge it; he has not yet seen these numbers. Measured on prod-calibrated-v001 at 1.85 m: baked-light correlation -0.24 against the 0.12 limit (a diagnostic in work/sunset-ayric-v2/texture/lighting-confound-v001.json shows part of it is a material-palette confound, part is real painter shading); texel density 301 texels/cm2 passes; 272 UV islands against the 250 advisory. Two head-detail paint candidates were rejected for doubled features (texture/hy3d21-head-v002/rejection.json). Ayric must confirm or revoke this waiver after the in-engine review before any production claim.
